skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the footage, add transitions, and sync background music automatically...

latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor in CapCut — Version 1.0.0

- Launches a chat-based AI video editor that processes uploads and editing instructions using CapCut cloud APIs.
- Enables automated video edits: trim footage, add transitions, sync background music, and export in minutes.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and exports 1080p MP4s optimized for social media.
- No technical setup: Anonymous token generation and session handling are automated on first use.
- Built-in error handling, credit checks, and status updates keep users informed throughout edits.
- Ideal for creators seeking quick, AI-driven video edits without learning full editing software.
